response.text: {"intro":"Fernwood Labs has 14 people in 5 teams. It runs on Bike with three apps: Categories, Requests and Allowances. Each one is a set of sheets, the steps a row moves through, and who can see and do what.","paragraphs":["Fernwood Labs has 14 people in 5 teams. Aisha Khan and Leo Grant have no manager recorded, so their reporting lines are not yet set. Wade owns all three apps, and the people list is used to fill the Who field in Requests and Allowances.","Spending at Fernwood Labs starts with a request. Anyone can add a request with a description and an amount, and can choose a category for it. Everyone sees their own requests. Krishna sees every request and can edit and move them through the steps: Submitted, then Approved, then Declined or Done. Nobody can approve or decline a request they asked for themselves.","The company has one rule on spending: requests over $1,000 are sent to the team leads. Submitted requests wait on the approver, so approval is how a decision reaches the person who must act on it.","Fernwood Labs keeps its spending organised with categories. Priya Nair and Dev Kumar see every category and can add and edit them. Everyone else can see them. Categories can sit under each other, up to 8 levels deep, and a category that has others under it can't be deleted.","Money given to people is tracked in Allowances. Priya Nair and Dev Kumar see every entry and add them, and everyone sees their own. Each entry can point to the request it came from, and it shows the person's balance after that entry. Entries are only added. They can't be changed or deleted, only reversed, and only once. Every change, made by hand or through Customize, is recorded in the Audit log."],"sentences":[{"capability":"Categories","sentence":"Categories holds the list of spending categories, which can sit under each other, and Priya Nair and Dev Kumar add and edit them while everyone can see them."},{"capability":"Requests","sentence":"Requests holds what people ask to spend, with the amount and category, and Krishna sees every request and moves them from Submitted to Approved, Declined or Done."},{"capability":"Allowances","sentence":"Allowances holds each person's allowance entries with a running balance, and Priya Nair and Dev Kumar add entries that can only be reversed, never changed or deleted."}],"phrases":[],"worth":["Aisha Khan and Leo Grant have no manager recorded, so anything that depends on a reporting line can't reach a manager for them.","The rule that requests over $1,000 go to the team leads is the only company rule, and the Requests app names Krishna as the one who sees and moves every request, so it is worth confirming who the team leads are."]}
